subject: Lightning Labs - Inference Roadshow Partnership & MDF split
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@lightninglabs.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partnerships@lightninglabs.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Lightning Labs x Redwood - Inference Roadshow APAC proposal

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — I’m Aisha on the partnerships team at Lightning Labs. We’ve been running a traveling ‘Inference Roadshow’ (hands-on demos + one-hour talks) across APAC and would love to co-run a stop with Redwood in Singapore and Melbourne this October/November. Audience: ~120 engineers + 30 product managers per city, strong attendance from fintech and retail verticals.

High-level ask from our side:
- Co-branded half-day event with one Redwood keynote and a 60-minute hands-on lab (Redwood supplies 1 speaker + 1 trainer).
- MDF: Lightning Labs typically contributes venue & on-the-ground ops; we ask partners for marketing MDF to cover paid acquisition and speaker travel. Proposed contribution: $25,000 from Redwood per city.
- Lead handling: Lightning handles registration & initial qualification; share CSV and MQLs within 48 hours post-event.

Attached: LightningLabs_MDF_proposal_v1.pdf (detailed audience demographics & pricing model) and a draft venue quote.

Do you have AM/PM availability for a quick 30-minute sync this week to discuss split, branding, and legal (co-marketing terms/MOU)? If you prefer, loop in whoever handles MDF and events ops.

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Partnerships
Lightning Labs
[Attachment: LightningLabs_MDF_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: venue_quote.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@lightninglabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightning Labs x Redwood - Inference Roadshow APAC proposal

Thanks Aisha — this looks promising. I’m available for a 30-min sync on Wed or Thu afternoon PST (that should work for APAC mornings).

Quick questions before we sync:
- Can you share attendee breakdown by company size (startup/enterprise) and the CPL assumptions that drove the $25k ask?
- Will Lightning be handling paid social creative or do you want Redwood to run joint campaigns (we can contribute assets but would prefer co-funded ad spend)?
- Any brand / co-marketing restrictions we should know about (logos, product mentions, NFR/demo limits)?

Looping in Marissa (field marketing) and Ben (partner programs) to weigh in on MDF tolerance and logistics. Marissa/Ben — do we have a target MDF threshold per city for APAC roadshows? If this moves forward we’ll need an MDF invoice, a short MOU, and a runsheet for on-site staffing.

-Jordan
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-24T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightning Labs x Redwood - Inference Roadshow APAC proposal

Thanks for the ping, Jordan — this is in my wheelhouse. We ran a similar co-hosted workshop earlier this year; some quick notes and recommendations below.

MDF and budget
- We typically cap partner MDF at $20k per city for smaller co-markets, $35k for larger flagship stops. Given the projected audience (120), I’m comfortable recommending a $20k MDF ask with a 60/40 shared paid-ad split (Redwood 60% / Lightning 40%) on acquisition spend so we control messaging. That gets us closer to efficient CPLs for enterprise targets.

Operational items
- Redwood deliverables: 1 keynote (30m), 1 hands-on lab (60m) with 1 trainer and 1 lab assistant. We’ll need staging + monitor for remote model demos and a small rack for demo hardware.
- Lightning deliverables: venue, registration, onsite crew, food & beverage, local sponsorships.
- Lead handoff: Lightning to provide CSV of registrants and post-event attendee engagement report within 72 hours. Redwood will ingest into HubSpot and run MQL scoring.

Legal / commercial
- We’ll need a short MOU and a co-marketing appendix outlining logos, naming, and data sharing. I’ve attached our MDF_request_template.xlsx for finance to review and a blank venue_quote.xlsx for your ops team. Please run Lightning’s standard co-marketing T&Cs past legal — anything unusual we’ll flag.

Next steps
1) Aisha: can you confirm you’re OK with $20k MDF and a 60/40 paid-ad split? Also send a tentative runsheet with proposed dates (we prefer Oct 18-20 for Singapore; Nov 15-17 for Melbourne).
2) Lightning: send venue invoice draft and registration link so we can review tracking & registration form fields.
3) If all good, legal can spin a short MOU + DocuSign.

Attaching: MDF_request_template.xlsx, venue_quote.xlsx

-Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MDF_request_template.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: venue_quote.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks Marissa — we can do the $20k MDF and the 60/40 paid-ad split. Confirming tentative dates: Singapore Oct 19 (preferred) and Melbourne Nov 16. We’ll send a draft venue invoice and the registration page today.

Two operational notes:
- Demo hardware: we ship a small rack of test devices from our Sydney office; will Redwood cover customs paperwork and local outbound shipping for the demo rack, or should Lightning handle last-mile?
- Insurance: venue requires a COI naming both Lightning Labs and Redwood; we’ll attach the draft invoice and the preliminary runsheet.
